features.title: Privacy by Design
features.description: Every feature engineered with your fundamental right to privacy
features.echoProtocolDetails: Our custom implementation of the Extended Triple Diffie-Hellman key agreement protocol ensures that your messages are encrypted before they even leave your device. We use AES-256-GCM for the highest level of security.
features.zeroKnowledgeDesc: We never see your data. Privacy by design.
features.zeroKnowledgeDetails: Our architecture is built so that we cannot access your private keys or messages.
features.forwardSecrecyDesc: Dynamic key rotation protects past chats.
features.forwardSecrecyDetails: If a key is ever compromised, it cannot be used to decrypt past messages.
features.ephemeralDetails: Configure messages to self-destruct after a set period.
features.groupChatsDetails: Group chats are encrypted using the Sender Keys protocol.
features.decentralizedDesc: No central servers. You control your data.
features.decentralizedDetails: Optional peer-to-peer architecture that eliminates single points of failure and ensures your communications don't depend on any central entity.
features.openSourceDetails: Our entire codebase is open source and available for audit.

milestones.title: Foundation
milestones.description: Standing up the full project stack from scratch.

details.label: Stack chosen
details.value: React 18, Vite 5, Tailwind CSS 3, Socket.io v4

details.label: Backend
details.value: Node.js + Express with Supabase (auth & DB)

details.label: Socket rooms
details.value: Per-conversation isolation via Socket.io rooms

details.label: Repo structure
details.value: Monorepo with independent Rust wasm crates

details.label: Auth
details.value: Supabase JWT with refresh token rotation

milestones.title: Crypto Core
milestones.description: All cryptographic primitives compiled to WebAssembly.

details.label: dh-wasm
details.value: wasm-pack Rust crate — 32-byte shared secret via X25519

details.label: xeddsa-wasm
details.value: Converts X25519 keypairs to Ed25519 for signing & verification

details.label: aes-wasm
details.value: AES-256-GCM: 12-byte IV, 16-byte auth tag, per-message keys

details.label: X3DH
details.value: IK + SPK + OPK bundle exchange with Double Ratchet seed

details.label: Key storage
details.value: Private keys kept in memory only, never written to localStorage

milestones.title: Product & UI
milestones.description: Full product surface: dashboard, chat, profiles, i18n, desktop.

items.text: Internationalisation — EN ES FR DE ZH

details.label: Chat features
details.value: Real-time typing indicators, read receipts, emoji reactions

details.label: File upload
details.value: Supabase Storage up to 50 MB — images preview inline

details.label: i18n
details.value: react-i18next with 5 locales; browser language auto-detected

details.label: Desktop
details.value: Tauri 2.0 — native system tray, OS notifications, auto-update

details.label: Friend system
details.value: Send/accept/reject requests, online presence via Socket.io

milestones.title: Public Release
milestones.description: Open-source launch, docs, and wiring encryption end-to-end.

details.label: GitHub release
details.value: MIT licence with SECURITY.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and issue templates

details.label: Docs site
details.value: API reference + integration guide + self-hosting walkthrough

details.label: AuthContext
details.value: Centralises JWT refresh, socket auth, and session persistence

details.label: Wasm loading
details.value: Crypto modules lazy-loaded in a dedicated Web Worker thread

details.label: CI / CD
details.value: GitHub Actions — lint, test, Vite build, Vercel preview deploy

milestones.title: Mobile
milestones.description: Native iOS and Android apps via Tauri mobile.

details.label: iOS bridge
details.value: Tauri mobile alpha — Swift-based platform plugin layer

details.label: Android bridge
details.value: Kotlin JNI bridge for Tauri mobile on Android 10+

details.label: Push gateway
details.value: FCM + APNs with E2E encrypted notification payloads

details.label: Offline queue
details.value: Local SQLite via tauri-plugin-sql for offline message storage

details.label: Crypto on mobile
details.value: Same wasm modules re-used via WKWebView / Android WebView

milestones.title: Enterprise
milestones.description: Group forward-secrecy, self-hosting, and SSO for teams.

details.label: Group crypto
details.value: Sender Keys protocol (Signal style) — O(1) encryption per member

details.label: Self-hosting
details.value: Docker image + Helm chart; Postgres-compatible DB required

details.label: SSO
details.value: SAML 2.0 + OIDC adapter with directory sync (SCIM)

details.label: Audit logs
details.value: Immutable audit trail for compliance (SOC 2, ISO 27001 path)

details.label: Admin panel
details.value: Web-based org management: roles, channels, data retention

details.label: PQC scheme
details.value: CRYSTALS-Kyber-1024 hybrid with X25519 (NIST PQC standard)

details.label: P2P routing
details.value: libp2p mesh with Kademlia DHT — no central relay required

details.label: Security audit
details.value: Trail of Bits or NCC Group — full crypto + infrastructure scope

details.label: Protocol spec
details.value: Public specification document for third-party implementations

details.label: Federation
details.value: Optional server federation so different deployments can message
